caption:
Sure your past disqualifies you? Grace shines loudest right there. (1 Timothy 1:15–17 devotional)

Paul calls himself chief of sinners — present tense. Not to wallow, but because the worst case saved first is the loudest proof no one after is too far gone. Your failure isn't a shame to bury; it's where mercy gets proven.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
